title: Re-review hn6 after its NOT READY review's blocking findings (round 2)
description:
Review the epic hn6 again, AS INTEGRATED, now that the blocking findings of its NOT READY review are fixed. This is review round 2 of at most 2.

The previous review (v16, decision 1) judged it NOT READY: stop the fabricated $0.00 (decisions line, cloud default), give stopped/failed/awaiting-merge runs a true verdict and needs-you, keep drill-in diff/report/gate data for settled and prior-run ticks, restore Ctrl-C detach (exit 5) under `ticfac run`, make the phone page render the same model for cloud runs, and remove the 8 RESULT-*.md reports from the epic branch; its blocking finding(s): "Cost still prints a fabricated $0.00: decisions line and cloud default 0"; "Ended runs get a false verdict, phase and needs-you (stopped reads done/healthy)"; "Drill-in shows no diff, report or gate evidence for settled and prior-run ticks"; "Ctrl-C/q on a terminal under `ticfac run` exits 1, not 5 'detached'"; "Phone page shows a different model for cloud runs and garbles verdicts"; "Epic branch carries 8 worker RESULT-*.md reports to main's root".

Judge the tree as it stands: READY when the epic does what it said it would, NOT READY naming what still blocks it. A NOT READY at this round is not reviewed again by the run: it holds for a person with your reasons.
